title: An electric dipole 5 nm from a 10 nm metal wire (n = 0.97 + 1.87i): the grazing caps' error against moving the guard
worst_label: largest difference / charged error (must stay below 1)
note: A electric dipole 5 nm from a 10 nm wire of n = 0.97 + 1.87i (no dispersion): near the light line the integrand is capped, and PyStratify charges the cap to its error. Integrating again with the precision guard moved inward to 3e-6 measures what the caps leave out; the largest difference over the total, escape and absorbed rates and the three orientations stays below the charge.
